title: HABC/19/2022 of ARIPIT Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND THROUGH SECRETARY HOME, GOVERNMENT OF U.K. DEHRADUN

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Habeas Corpus Petition No. 19 of 2022
Arpit ..........Petitioner
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and others ........ Respondents

Present : Mr. Rakshit Joshi, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Lalit Miglani, A.G.A. with Ms. Sonika Khulbe, Brief
Holder for the State.

JUDGMENT
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 This habeas corpus petition has been filed
seeking liberty of his wife and protecting her life.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would
submit that he and Priyanka, who is daughter of the
respondent no.3 were married on 30.05.2022. The
marriage was subsequently registered also, but now, the
respondent no.3 has unlawfully detained the corpus. The
petitioner has apprehension that there is threat to the life
of Priyanka.

2
4. During the course of hearing, learned State
counsel invited attention of the Court to FIR No.304 of
2022, Police Station Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar,
lodged by Priyanka against the petitioner and others for
the offences punishable under Sections 323, 354, 504,
506 IPC. According to this FIR, the applicant molested the
corpus, spiked her drink and in the state of
unconsciousness, by playing fraud got prepared marriage
certificate, prepared her videos and threatened her.
5. What is important to note in this petition is
that the FIR was filed by Priyanka not in the police
station, but she moved an application in the court of
Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar,
under Section 156(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973. It appears that application was allowed by the court
and order for investigation had been made. The petitioner
is an accused, the corpus has attributed various unlawful
acts to the petitioner. In such circumstances, the writ of
habeas corpus cannot be entertained. It is the
Investigating Officer of FIR No.304 of 2022, Police Station
Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar to investigate and
find the truth of the matter. Accordingly the petition
deserves to be dismissed at the admission stage.

3
6. The petition is dismissed in limine.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 11.10.2022
Sanjay
